ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low high-to-low intensity ratio; the surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized anomalies and linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The pigmentation is largely homogeneous dark-grey/black. Discrete high-contrast pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes and sparse linear strings distributed across the interior lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 75-85 degrees; depth is moderate, approximately 10% of the vertical lobe height at the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips; extreme distal tips exhibit highly irregular, jagged pixel boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep from the median notch, following a slightly convex curve along the leading edges towards the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters on the distal tips of both lobes; isolated circular high-intensity spots are visible on the inner-middle section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear tracks; one prominent vertical scratch on the left lobe and several shorter, diagonal scratches on the inner section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured white masses on both distal tips; a small irregular indentation is visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe proximal to the tip.
